_readme: 'Find your seat' role tracks (SPEC 5.2). Each 'name' must match an entry in projects.json -> disciplines; the projects shown under a track are pulled automatically from projects tagged with that discipline. 'what_you_do' items are written ONLY from the scope of real projects and name the project they come from ('project' = project id). 'fits' is a SUGGESTED mapping of majors and interests, taken from the inferred 'fits' of the projects in this track (projects.json, fit_inferred: true); it does not mean members of those majors have done this work. Officers: correct it to match who actually worked on these projects. The /join/ matcher searches each track's 'fits' and 'skills' only. A what_you_do item without a real project is not allowed (officers: add design-focused work such as user research or prototyping here once a project has done it). Find your seat (/join/): each tile shows 'short' (one line); the panel shows the three what_you_do items marked "panel": true, the first 5 'skills', the first 5 'fits' (so order them by importance) and up to 3 recent projects in the track (automatic). The full lists stay here and are all used for matching.

tracks.name: Data & Engineering
tracks.summary: Build the models, databases and dashboards a client's decisions run on.

what_you_do.text: Source data and assess whether a machine-learning approach is viable.
Refine and benchmark forecasting models, including a time-series model and an LSTM.
Configure a Google Cloud SQL database and connect it to Looker Studio.
Rebuild a test-score dashboard segmented by demographics, district and state.
Build a Python ETL pipeline and a REST API that make public school data queryable.

tracks.short: Models, databases and dashboards for client decisions.

tracks.name: Strategy & Research
tracks.summary: Research the landscape, benchmark what works and turn it into a plan.

what_you_do.text: Develop monetization and legal-compliance strategy for a machine-learning startup.
Benchmark best practices from organizations comparable to the client.
Recommend a marketing approach to strengthen campus presence and outreach.
Build a five-year financial plan and pricing strategy for a school-safety startup.
Plan a two-year client outreach strategy, target list and playbook.

tracks.short: Research, benchmarks and plans a client can act on.

tracks.name: Product & Design
tracks.summary: Scope the work and design the processes product teams run on.

what_you_do.text: Build a client-outreach process for a new product-design organization.
Map a timeline and process flow so the organization can grow and handle leadership turnover.
Write a user-experience and product opportunity brief from hands-on use of an AI public-speaking platform.

tracks.short: Scoping and processes for product teams.

tracks.name: Operations & People
tracks.summary: Design roles, documentation and processes that last beyond one semester.

what_you_do.text: Set up a knowledge-management system so documentation survives leadership changes.
Plan how senior members stay engaged and how presentation quality improves.
Document operating procedures from recruitment through client acquisition.
Write a leadership framework and a semester-to-semester transition guide.

tracks.short: Roles, documentation and processes that last.
